name: Crimson Terraplate Pauldrons
desc: For much of modern zoology, Crimson Terrapods were thought only to be a myth, only known to exist among a small cohort of naturalist Divers. This ambiguity ended when Authority scouts arrived in newly emerged Erisia, where a particularly audacious Warden managed not only to find and slay one, but craft its shell into an armor much like this one. Its even rumored that after wearing it for long enough, he began to take on many of the Terrapods more aggressive mannerisms.
